name: Content scaling: authentic maps keep their authored levels, other maps are still scaled
contract: Requires CoAContentScaling.Enable=1 with the TBC and WotLK packs at cap 60 (Classic 1-45) and
CoAContentScaling.AuthenticMaps listing Molten Core (409) but not the Sunken Temple (109). On an authentic map
a creature keeps its authored level, entry asks for the authored minimum level, and an item whose every
spawned source is there keeps its authored item and required level. Molten Giant 11658 is authored at 62,
Molten Core asks for 60, and Band of Sulfuras 19138 drops only from Ragnaros, an encounter-summoned boss,
at item level 70 and required level 60. Scaled, these would sit in the Classic band at 45 or below. The
Sunken Temple keeps being scaled: Atal'ai Witch Doctor 5259 (authored 49-50), its access level (35) and
Vestments of the Atal'ai Prophet 10806 (required level 50) all move below their authored values.

steps.label: A Molten Core creature keeps its authored level 62
Molten Core asks for its authored level 60
Band of Sulfuras keeps item level 70
The Sunken Temple asks for less than its authored 35
A Sunken Temple item asks for less than its authored 50
A Sunken Temple creature stands below its authored 49
